subject.title: Add gated Claw hosted feed and lifecycle proof

question: Should ClawHub sponsor the experimental public Claw package and hosted-feed contract, with the deployment gate retained while the four-slice stack lands?
rationale: The implementation is directionally aligned with VISION.md, but choosing this external registry contract, its rollout order, and the conditions for enabling it is a product and compatibility decision rather than a mechanical code-review outcome.

options.title: Sponsor the gated staged rollout
options.body: Accept the experimental contract, keep CLAWHUB_EXPERIMENTAL_CLAWS required, and review/land the prerequisite stack in order before this feed slice.

options.title: Defer the contract decision
options.body: Keep the stack open as a draft until the RFC and maintainers establish the intended public feed and upgrade contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated staged rollout
recommendation.body: Accept the experimental contract, keep CLAWHUB_EXPERIMENTAL_CLAWS required, and review/land the prerequisite stack in order before this feed slice.

likelyOwner.reason: The current vision history is the strongest available evidence for ownership of the ClawHub product boundary this PR expands.
